Saudi Arabia faces limited options amid regional threats

Saudi Arabia is confronting a complex regional security landscape with limited strategic options, according to multiple international news outlets. The kingdom faces mounting threats from Iran and its allied Houthi rebels in Yemen. In response to these challenges, Saudi Arabia is reportedly seeking assistance from the United States, with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman meeting with the head of U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM). The conflict with the Houthis, in particular, presents a difficult situation for Saudi Arabia, offering few clear paths forward.
